evidence: Part (a) asks for the meaning of the 0.9 entry in the transition matrix.

The markscheme awards the interpretation of 0.9 as the probability of a vegetarian remaining vegetarian, then marks the determinant equation/eigenvalues and the non-parallel eigenvector (1,2) with its long-run ratio.
repairs.rationale: Transition matrices and Markov chains are independently mark-bearing in part (a), so retain the skill and add its canonical owner Statistics and probability; eigenvalues and eigenvectors remain owned by Number and algebra.

evidence: Part (a) awards the sketch of f(x)=e^x−3x−4, including its roots, y-intercept/local minimum, and end behavior.

evidence: Part (c)(i) asks for the modulus and argument of z=(1−cos2θ)−i sin2θ; the markscheme awards |z|=2sinθ and arg(z)=θ−π/2.

evidence: The question asks for the number of roots of f(x)=px^2+qx−4p with p≠0 and requires a justification.
The markscheme awards discriminant setup/substitution, q^2+16p^2, positivity from p≠0 and q^2≥0, and the conclusion that f has two roots across 7 marks.
repairs.rationale: The discriminant and positivity argument are explicitly marked equation/inequality work, so retain Equations and inequalities and add its canonical owner Number and algebra; Functions remains primary and no production skill is mechanically unioned in.
